timeline.event: Muga Silk of Assam was registered as a geographical indication.
A registered GI logo for muga silk followed, strengthening authentication of genuine products.
A comparative study of commercial silks found muga and other non-mulberry fibers more extensible than Bombyx mori silk.
Muga silk fibroin constructs were studied for cartilage tissue engineering.
A study assessed the air pollution tolerance of som, the muga silkworm's primary host tree, near industrial sites.
Reference genes were validated for RT-qPCR studies of Antheraea assamensis under bacterial and viral infection.

production.year: as reported in the 2025-26 annual report
production.scope: Indian muga silk, about 0.6% of India's raw silk output

timeline.event: British Celanese Ltd., founded by Camille and Henri Dreyfus, began commercial production of diacetate yarn.
Fine aqueous dispersions of sparingly soluble dyes were developed to color acetate, the origin of the disperse dye class.
A review estimated acetate at about 13% of regenerated cellulose fiber output, roughly 0.95 million tonnes.

Mitsubishi Chemical began producing Soalon triacetate yarn at its Toyama plant, according to the producer.
Mitsubishi Chemical Group agreed to transfer its triacetate fiber business to GSI Creos.

timeline.event: Matthias Eduard Schweizer found that cotton dissolves in a solution of copper salts in ammonia.
Louis-Henri Despeissis patented spinning fibers from cuprammonium cellulose solutions.
J. P. Bemberg began selling fine stretch-spun cuprammonium artificial silk under the Bemberg name.
Japanese cupro production began at Nobeoka, after J. P. Bemberg licensed its process to Shitagau Noguchi in 1928.

timeline.event: Antonio Ferretti received an Italian patent for a casein fiber.
SNIA Viscosa began marketing Ferretti's casein fiber as Lanital.
Henry Ford was photographed on his 78th birthday in a suit containing soybean protein fiber developed at Ford.
Qmilch was founded in Germany to make fiber largely from casein recovered from milk unfit for sale.

Speakman and Chamberlain published on producing rayon from alginic acid.
Courtaulds sought patent protection for a nonwoven alginate fiber material for wound dressings.

timeline.event: The US Federal Trade Commission granted PLA its own generic fiber name after a petition by Cargill Dow.
Regulation (EU) No 1007/2011 listed polylactide as a fibre name, with a minimum melting temperature of 135 C.
A marine study found no measurable degradation of PLA textiles after 428 days in seawater, while cellulose fibers degraded in about 35 days.
